entities.summary: "Can't Remember to Forget You" is a song recorded by Colombian singer Shakira from her tenth studio album, Shakira, featuring guest vocals from Barbadian singer Rihanna. Shakira began planning to make new music in 2011: work continued into 2012, at which time she left her previous label Epic Records and joined RCA Records. The song was released as the lead single of the album on 13 January 2014 through RCA Records. A solo Spanish-language version of the song, entitled "Nunca Me Acuerdo de Olvidarte", was released on 24 January 2014 via Sony Music Latin.
